registers.intro: Each statement opens with its filters and exports to xlsx, csv or PDF.

kinds.vat_by_rate: Output VAT by rate and period
kinds.vat_deductible: Deductible VAT on purchases, with invoices paid in cash above the limit
kinds.stamp_duty_statement: Stamp duty per day and till, credit payments included

archive.intro: A copy of every document, the action log and the Z closes of a period. It shows if anything was changed later. Keep it ten years.
archive.chainsBroken: A change was found in the documents: the archive shows where. Contact DZBuild support.
archive.verifyOk: Archive intact: no file was changed since the export.
